blocks.text: Cloud deployment models batate hain ke cloud services kaise dastiyab aur istemal hoti hain. Har ek control, hifazat aur lachak ka mukhtalif darja deta hai. Bare models public, private, hybrid aur multi-cloud hain.

blocks.prompt: Cloud deployment models ki tareef kar ke farq aur misalein dijiye (long questions 2 aur 8).
blocks.explanation: Deployment model batata hai ke cloud ka malik kaun aur kaun share karta hai. Public: kai idaron mein mushtarak, AWS jaisa provider chalata hai; sab se sasta aur barhana aasan, magar kam control. Private: ek idara istemal karta hai, maslan bank ka apna data centre; sab se zyada control aur hifazat, magar sab se mehnga. Hybrid: public aur private, maslan rozmarra kaam public mein aur hassas data private mein, masroof waqt mein izafi bojh public par; lachakdar. Multi-cloud: kai providers ki services, maslan analytics ke liye Google Cloud, karobari apps ke liye Azure aur backup ke liye AWS; mazboot aur ek provider par inhisar se bachata hai.

items: Deployment: public (mushtarak), private (ek idara), hybrid (dono), multi-cloud (kai providers).
